UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information representing an authenticated person.

photoURL.description: User avatar photo URL if available

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when profile was last updated

UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Active in-progress workspace state containing current mode, prompt inputs, and results.

ownerId.description: The UID of the verified user owning this workspace

isFacelessCreator.description: Whether the faceless creator toggle is active

showAdvisory.description: Whether the identity prerequisite advisory note is visible

generatedPhrases.description: Curated Pinterest search phrases generated for visual or signature mark

generatedFingerprint.description: Generated emoji fingerprint payload if applicable

generatedColorWorld.description: Generated color palette and mood line if applicable

SavedCreation.title: SavedCreation
SavedCreation.description: A saved generation result archived in the user's private library.

ownerId.description: The UID of the verified user who owns this result

mode.description: Mode under which result was produced

title.description: Title or descriptive label for the saved item

isFacelessCreator.description: Whether faceless creator mode was active

generatedFingerprint.description: Emoji fingerprint result if mode was fingerprints

generatedColorWorld.description: Color world palette result if mode was color

generatedBlueprint.description: Curation blueprint result if mode was visual or signature

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private user account information accessible only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Stores user active workspace progress and state, strictly isolated to the owner.

/users/{userId}/creations/{creationId}.description: Stores user's permanently archived results and generations, accessible only by owner.
